title: Instagram — Problem Definition
subtitle: Photo sharing at scale with personalized feeds

nodes.label:
Upload, Feed
Stories, Likes
Follow System

panels.title: Functional Requirements
panels.body:
- Upload photos/videos with filters
- User timelines and home feeds
- Follow/unfollow and social graph
- Like and comment interactions
- Stories (24h ephemeral content)
- Explore (recommendations)

panels.title: Out-of-Scope
panels.body:
- Direct Messaging (DMs)
- Reels video engine (TikTok style)
- Shopping and Marketplace
- Ad serving platform
- Live streaming
